The study finds that the environmental impact of clothing depends more on dyes, finishes, and treatments used throughout production, wear, and disposal. This raises concerns about chemical use in India's large textile industry, which could influence future environmental and health policies.
articles.raw_summary: Many consumers assume that natural fibres are automatically kinder to the environment than synthetic alternatives. A new systematic review of textile chemistry complicates this rule of thumb, showing that the environmental cost of a garment depends less on fibre origin than on the dyes, finishes and performance treatments applied throughout production, wear, disposal and recycling stages.

articles.title: Energy sector in spotlight as cyberattack threat grows
articles.summary: The energy sector in India faces rising cyberattack risks as information technology and operational technology converge in modernized networks. Energy companies have rapidly upgraded systems to improve service delivery, creating complex cyber-physical systems that are difficult to secure. This trend raises concerns about vulnerabilities in critical infrastructure and the need for stronger cybersecurity measures in the energy sector.
articles.raw_summary: The age of convergence describes the rapid connectivity in recent years as information and operational technology have come together in unprecedented ways. These two environments were historically kept separate, but as energy companies have rapidly modernised their networks to improve service delivery, these two worlds have converged. The result is complex cyber-physical systems that are difficult to secure.

The US Geological Survey linked the disaster to glacial collapse, causing severe impacts in Nepal and Tibet. Fresh flood warnings have been issued for the Bhotekoshi river. The event is among Nepal's worst disasters in recent years.
